product_launches.description: A smartwatch with a sunlight-readable e-paper screen, long battery life, physical buttons, and a customizable OS.

overview_description.description: Pebble manufactures smartwatch-based fitness wearables. Their watch can be paired with both iPhones and BlackBerry phones, enabling users to view notifications at a glance as well as help customers track their health conditions, including steps, distance, active time, and calories burned; plus, it sends quick summaries right after an activity.
